summary: Issue #273 replaces the Cameras placeholder and fabricated Overview LIVE scenes with a truthful authenticated local-first camera inventory and readiness workspace. The slice will expose only validated browser-safe metadata and explicit availability states without credentials, unsupported RTSP playback claims, camera mutations, cloud requirements or physical acceptance claims.

authenticated cameras workspace with deterministic search and bounded filters
truthful Overview integration without fabricated LIVE evidence
explicit unsupported media and hardware boundary
focused tests and authenticated browser acceptance with zero mutations

no recording, archive, PTZ, microphone or speaker control
no camera CRUD, provisioning, secret rotation or hardware write
no mandatory cloud, CDN, telemetry or paid runtime service
no ONVIF or media gateway claim without implementation evidence
no dependency migration or unrelated refactor

hardware_evidence.note: Physical cameras, ONVIF, RTSP media, NVR and LAN/VPN access remain unverified.

next_ready_work_package_step.instruction: Open one focused draft Pull Request, implement the typed camera domain and focused tests, then replace the /cameras placeholder and fabricated Overview LIVE panel.
